schema.text: What would help you choose an alternative to the car for some of your trips?

options.text: More frequent and reliable public transport, also in the evening
Knowing it's better for the environment
I need the car for my situation (e.g., disability, children, loads, work shifts)
Routes and vehicles that are accessible for my disability or health condition
Nothing: the car suits my trips
Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (e.g. health, age, carrying things)

en.#Knowing it's better for the environment: Knowing it's better for the environment
en.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: I need the car for my situation (e.g., disability, children, loads, work shifts)
en.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Routes and vehicles that are accessible for my disability or health condition
en.#Nothing: the car suits my trips: Nothing: the car suits my trips
en.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (e.g. health, age, carrying things)
en.#More frequent and reliable public trans: More frequent and reliable public transport, also in the evening
en.#What would help you choose an alternati: What would help you choose an alternative to the car for some of your trips?

it.#Quicker or more reliable journeys: Spostamenti più rapidi o più affidabili
it.#Feeling more confident using them: Sentirmi più a mio agio nell'usarli
it.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Per le mie esigenze l’auto è necessaria (es. disabilità, figli, assistenza ad altre persone, carichi, turni di lavoro)
it.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Percorsi e mezzi accessibili per la mia disabilità o condizione di salute
it.#Nothing: the car suits my trips: Nessuna: per i miei spostamenti l’auto va bene
it.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: Non mi riguarda: non posso camminare o pedalare a lungo (es. per motivi di salute o perché porto pesi)
it.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Un trasporto pubblico più frequente e affidabile, anche di sera
it.#What would help you choose an alternati: Cosa ti aiuterebbe a scegliere un’alternativa all’auto per alcuni tuoi spostamenti?

fr.#Quicker or more reliable journeys: Des trajets plus rapides ou plus fiables
fr.#Safer streets and routes: Des rues et des itinéraires plus sûrs
fr.#Better pavements and cycle lanes: De meilleurs trottoirs et pistes cyclables
fr.#More comfort and convenience: Plus de confort et de praticité
fr.#Feeling more confident using them: Me sentir plus en confiance pour les utiliser
fr.#Better weather (less heat or rain): Un meilleur temps (moins de chaleur ou de pluie)
fr.#Knowing it's better for the environment: Savoir que c'est mieux pour l'environnement
fr.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: J'ai besoin de la voiture dans ma situation (par ex. handicap, enfants, charges, horaires de travail décalés)
fr.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Des itinéraires et des véhicules accessibles compte tenu de mon handicap ou de mon état de santé
fr.#Nothing: the car suits my trips: Rien : la voiture convient à mes trajets
fr.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: Cela ne me concerne pas : je ne peux pas marcher ou pédaler longtemps (par ex. santé, âge, charges à porter)
fr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Des transports en commun plus fréquents et plus fiables, y compris le soir
fr.#What would help you choose an alternati: Qu’est-ce qui vous aiderait à choisir une alternative à la voiture pour certains de vos déplacements ?

de.#Knowing it's better for the environment: Zu wissen, dass es besser für die Umwelt ist
de.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Ich bin in meiner Situation auf das Auto angewiesen (z. B. Behinderung, Kinder, Lasten, Schichtarbeit)
de.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Wege und Fahrzeuge, die für meine Behinderung oder meinen Gesundheitszustand zugänglich sind
de.#Nothing: the car suits my trips: Nichts: Das Auto passt zu meinen Wegen
de.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: Trifft auf mich nicht zu: Ich kann nicht weit gehen oder Rad fahren (z. B. wegen Gesundheit, Alter, Tragen von Sachen)
de.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Häufigere und zuverlässigere öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, auch am Abend
de.#What would help you choose an alternati: Was würde Ihnen helfen, für einige Ihrer Wege eine Alternative zum Auto zu wählen?

tr.#Quicker or more reliable journeys: Daha hızlı veya daha güvenilir yolculuklar
tr.#Better pavements and cycle lanes: Daha iyi kaldırımlar ve bisiklet yolları
tr.#Feeling more confident using them: Bunları kullanırken kendime daha çok güvenmek
tr.#Better weather (less heat or rain): Daha iyi hava (daha az sıcak veya yağmur)
tr.#Knowing it's better for the environment: Çevre için daha iyi olduğunu bilmek
tr.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Durumum gereği arabaya ihtiyacım var (ör. engellilik, çocuklar, yük taşıma, vardiyalı çalışma)
tr.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Engelime veya sağlık durumuma uygun, erişilebilir güzergâhlar ve araçlar
tr.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: Bu soru benim için geçerli değil: Uzun yürüyemem veya bisiklet süremem (örn. sağlık, yaş, taşınacak eşyalar)
tr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Akşamları da dahil olmak üzere daha sık ve güvenilir toplu taşıma
tr.#What would help you choose an alternati: Bazı yolculuklarınızda otomobil yerine başka bir ulaşım seçeneği seçmenize ne yardımcı olurdu?

fa.#Feeling more confident using them: احساس اطمینان بیشتر هنگام استفاده از آن‌ها
fa.#Knowing it's better for the environment: دانستن اینکه برای محیط زیست بهتر است
fa.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: با شرایطی که دارم به خودرو نیاز دارم (مثلاً معلولیت، کودکان، بار، شیفت کاری)
fa.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: مسیرها و وسایل نقلیه‌ای که برای معلولیت یا وضعیت سلامتی من قابل دسترسی باشند
fa.#Nothing: the car suits my trips: هیچ چیز: خودرو برای سفرهای من مناسب است
fa.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: مربوط به من نیست: نمی‌توانم راه دور پیاده بروم یا دوچرخه‌سواری کنم (مثلاً به دلیل سلامتی، سن، حمل بار)
fa.#More frequent and reliable public trans: حمل‌ونقل عمومی پرتکرارتر و قابل‌اعتمادتر، حتی در عصر و شب
fa.#What would help you choose an alternati: چه چیزی به شما کمک می‌کند برای بعضی از رفت‌وآمدهایتان گزینه‌ای به‌جای خودرو انتخاب کنید؟

hu.#Knowing it's better for the environment: Annak tudata, hogy jobb a környezetnek
hu.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: A helyzetem miatt szükségem van az autóra (pl. fogyatékosság, gyerekek, csomagok, műszakos munka)
hu.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: A fogyatékosságomnak vagy egészségi állapotomnak megfelelően akadálymentes útvonalak és járművek
hu.#Nothing: the car suits my trips: Semmi: az autó megfelel az utaimhoz
hu.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: Rám nem vonatkozik: nem tudok messzire gyalogolni vagy biciklizni (pl. egészségi állapot, életkor, cipelnivaló miatt)
hu.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Gyakoribb és megbízhatóbb tömegközlekedés, este is
hu.#What would help you choose an alternati: Mi segítene abban, hogy egyes útjaihoz az autó helyett más közlekedési módot válasszon?

ar.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: أحتاج إلى السيارة بسبب ظروفي (مثل الإعاقة أو الأطفال أو الأحمال أو نوبات العمل)
ar.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: طرق ومركبات يسهل استخدامها مع إعاقتي أو حالتي الصحية
ar.#Not for me: I can't walk or cycle far (: لا ينطبق عليّ: لا أستطيع المشي أو ركوب الدراجة لمسافة بعيدة (مثلًا بسبب الصحة أو السن أو حمل الأشياء)
ar.#More frequent and reliable public trans: نقل عام أكثر تواترًا وموثوقية، حتى في المساء
ar.#What would help you choose an alternati: ما الذي يساعدك على اختيار بديل للسيارة في بعض تنقلاتك؟
